name: @tradew/strategy-core
description: The ONE decision framework. Feature/context building, setup detection, structural level derivation and the 1:3 risk validator — shared verbatim by the autonomous paper/live engine, the backtester and Sentinel. Pure functions over a MarketSnapshot: no I/O, no Nest, no venue knowledge.

scripts.//build:if-stale: Same outcome as `build`, but a no-op when src/ has not changed since the last build. Used by the predev hooks of every service that imports this package, so a service can never boot against a stale decision core. Conditional rather than unconditional because start:all boots several of them concurrently — see scripts/build-if-stale.mjs.
